lane.close.title: Close lane
lane.close.summary: Claim the issue first. Close a merged lane with a PASS receipt, or a CLOSED unmerged PR with a dropped reason. Refuse active run locks and dirty work; resume matching close journals. keepOpen preserves the issue; discardIgnored authorizes other ignored files.

lane.start.title: Start lane
lane.start.summary: Start a capped worktree for an open issue. Brief must be in the project with Goal, Acceptance test, Files, Forbidden actions, Stop point and Prior art sections. Repeating the same arguments adopts a preserved worktree.

lane.next.title: Next lane action
lane.next.summary: After a merge, return the next action for the lane from fresh facts: receipt at the merge commit, lane close, other delivered issues, configured rebuild, unwatch, done. Repeating it returns the same action until its fact holds. Unknown or mismatched facts return a pause with an ask.

lane.record.title: Record lane action
lane.record.summary: Record a fact Forge cannot read itself for the open action number, as a JSON object in result: a receipt id, a rebuild exit code or an unwatch confirmation.

lane.show.title: Show lane
lane.show.summary: Read the recorded lane and issue lease without changing either.

issue.show.title: Issue show
issue.show.summary: Read issue and live lease only.

issue.list.title: List
issue.list.summary: List: ready=open, deps closed, no live lease; labels/label=all-of; parent=id/none; kind. Filters AND. createdSince: inclusive full RFC 3339 timestamp, before limit; truncated: more matches.

issue.update.title: Update
issue.update.summary: Update at show revision with held lease. kind: task/bug/feature/epic; open epics with open children cannot be demoted. parent: existing id/null to clear; no cycles.

examples.command: POSIX: forge issue update demo-1 --title "Updated task" --expect-revision "$(forge issue show demo-1 | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).result.revision')"
PowerShell 5.1: forge issue update demo-1 --title "Updated task" --expect-revision ((forge issue show demo-1 | ConvertFrom-Json).result.revision)

issue.comment.title: Comment
issue.comment.summary: Append plain comment; read via issue.comments.

issue.claim.title: Claim
issue.claim.summary: Lease an open issue for this session. ttlSeconds overrides claimTtlSeconds (default 3600s).

issue.renew.title: Renew
issue.renew.summary: Renew live generation/reacquire expired lease. ttlSeconds overrides claimTtlSeconds (default 3600s).

issue.close.title: Close
issue.close.summary: Close with held lease and verified PASS receipt bound to delivered PR, or written withoutReceipt reason.

issue.ready.title: Ready
issue.ready.summary: Open, deps closed, no live lease (expired/released OK). All labels match. /blocks/work/config/labelOrder: first listed label carried, then stored order.

issue.stale.title: Stale
issue.stale.summary: Open issues with expired, unreleased leases.

issue.call.title: Call
issue.call.summary: Count root intent call; refuse after 60 calls/30 hours; return bounded timebox.

issue.events.title: Events
issue.events.summary: Read accepted issue and lease history.

issue.dep.title: Dep
issue.dep.summary: Add/remove dependency with held lease and expected revision.

examples.command: POSIX: forge issue dep --id demo-1 --target demo-2 --action add --expect-revision "$(forge issue show demo-1 | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).result.revision')"
PowerShell 5.1: forge issue dep --id demo-1 --target demo-2 --action add --expect-revision ((forge issue show demo-1 | ConvertFrom-Json).result.revision)

issue.link.title: Link
issue.link.summary: Attach typed external link with held lease.

issue.tree.title: Tree
issue.tree.summary: Open epics or root id; open/closed child counts, open descendants to depth 3, parent anomalies. limit bounds nodes/ids; truncated includes deeper children.

issue.lint.title: Lint
issue.lint.summary: Check kinds, references, dep cycles, open issues with closed parents (always). labels.required: exactly one match/group; default empty.
